description: I am a Class 9 student from Kolkata, India, with a deep curiosity about science and the mysteries of the universe. I am particularly passionate about Physics, Astronomy, Cosmology, and Chemical Science. Wormholes, spacetime curvature, black holes, general relativity, and higher dimensions fascinate me. I love exploring challenging scientific ideas, questioning existing theories, and learning how the universe works. My dream is to contribute to scientific research and innovation.
summary:

details:
My project, SPHEREx Time Explorer, is an idea developed by Team Einstein Bridge. The main aim of this project is to make space exploration easier and more interesting for students and other people.

The idea is to create a simple web tool where users can explore images and observations collected by NASA's SPHEREx mission. They can compare observations of the same region of the sky taken at different times and learn about objects that move or change.

The project also introduces different astronomical objects such as comets, asteroids, stars, galaxies, nebulae, neutron stars, supernovae and black holes.

I prepared a seven-slide presentation to explain my idea, the science behind it and its possible benefits. I used Microsoft PowerPoint to prepare the presentation and Google Drive to share it.

As a Class 9 student, I wanted to explore something beyond my textbooks and learn how NASA uses technology and scientific data to understand our universe. I hope this idea encourages more students to become interested in astronomy.
